Expected predictor / TF-IDF & 1,096 questions and \Field{official_type}-derived proxy labels; T5 fixed as required & TF-IDF and classifier fitting for the sample's Expected output excludes i; fitting is not nested within risk folds.\\
Observed extractor & Pretrained model, fixed prompt and parser; question, Frozen Initial Answer, and ordered Top-6 & No local project training; i is an inference input. Existing records do not establish membership in model pretraining.\\

Risk Logistic Regression & Each risk training fold and Initial EM-error labels & The Initial correctness label of held-out i does not participate in classifier fitting.\\
